title: The bag, packed
logline: A bag with a strap on a made bed, packed, zipped, in a room he never saw — her room the night before. Drawn from nothing: a bed, a bag, a window with the bay in it, a lamp off. The page before the route.

panels.composition: A canvas bag with a strap sitting packed and zipped on a tightly made bed in a small bedroom, a window with a gray bay beyond, a lamp switched off, a jacket over a chair.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a canvas bag with a strap sitting packed and zipped on a tightly made bed in a small bedroom with a window showing a gray bay, a lamp switched off and a jacket over a chair, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
